oraclePolicy: The tool return value is never its own correctness evidence. Channels read: durable guard-consult facts, confined-spawn counters, on-disk markers, World transcript/ledger, mock connection counters, /proc tripwire, host-pid liveness. tests/world-factory/lib/oracle.mjs was not directly wired (see README section 7.6).

cases.decisive: six boots: A6-11 PASS 6/6; A6-12 4 FAIL consumed=true file="" (r1,r3,r5,r6) and 2 PASS consumed=false file="" (r2,r4); late allow rejected CONTROL_REQUEST_DECIDED 6/6; consumption at +83..110 ms after the allow decision, simultaneous with the cancel; effect file empty 6/6
cases.oracle: late-allow RPC body + last durable decision + consumption fact + effect file
cases.falsifier: a boot with a side effect, or a post-Stop consumption far outside the ~100 ms window, would change the characterisation
cases.note: race between the Stop/cancel acknowledgement and the consumption step of the pre-Stop allow; the second allow is rejected in all six, so it is not the source. No side effect observed. Rate 4/6 = 67%.

cases.falsifier: a stopped-*.json marker would flip this; none exists
cases.note: consistent with RELEASE-NOTES-0.1.6 section 4.7 latch-scoped marker limit; recorded as reproduced limit, not a new defect

cases.note: D11 / release-notes section 5 known path; kit check FAIL is by design because its ok predicate excludes abandoned-terminal

disagreements.treatment: reported as a product race with the observed rate; not averaged

notes: Ten single-boot kit runs (two per arm), all at the frozen SHA and host pin. Allow path, single consumption/execution and SIGKILL cold recovery pass in both boots. Deny/throw arms never reach a durable request (base permission fallback), Sticky Stop writes no durable marker (documented 4.7 limit), A6-26 reproduces the documented abandonment, and Stop-vs-consumption disagrees between boots.
verdictBasis: Deny and throw arms PASS on the corrected invocation. Overall NOT PASS rests on (1) the A6-12 Stop consumption race (4/6, 67%), (2) Sticky Stop writing no durable marker (both boots, documented 4.7 limit), (3) the exact A6-on + governed Goal-authorisation conjunction not established. No candidateClaimEligibility is asserted.
